summary: ReVamp will get a limited Discord playtest.
body: The studio behind the Moonlighter series has announced it will no longer host a public playtest for its forthcoming roguelike due to fears it will be "reverse-engineered, cloned and published". The move comes as a surge in rapidly vibe coded clones floods Steam, Roblox and mobile app stores in the aftermath of Claude Opus 5.5. "With launch still months away, sharing a build with tens of thousands of players feels like too big a risk," Digital Sun Games' marketing manager Israel Mallén told PC Gamer. The game under discussion is ReVamp , a "tower defensevania" roguelike due for release in March 2027. "We know we're not the only developers feeling this way, and the more this is talked about, the more likely platforms are to step in." In its public announcement Digital Sun Games was fairly blunt. title: Star Wars Zero Company adds new difficulty options that can bring it closer to XCOM
summary: Turning up the heat a little.
body: Star Wars Zero Company's 1.2 patch introduces a new granular difficulty system in addition to the usual bugfixes and tweaks. These new options exist alongside the original difficulty levels (easy, normal, hard, ironman beskarboy etc.), and home in on more creative/tactical tweaks, rather than just beefing up enemies. The highlights: You can remove the injury system, so downed operatives are instantly killed. Alternatively, you can lower the injury allowance before permadeath, and/or add a risk of death to getting downed. The patch allows you to lower or eliminate health scaling, so operatives are more fragile by the end of the game. It also allows you to restrict the respec function by degrees, removing class and even weapon swapping. I like these options a lot: They're sharp, targeted changes that make Zero Company harder by restricting your options, forcing you to think and play more creatively. The game's normal, default difficulty, with all of these modifiers added, represents a more interesting challenge to me than the shipped hard mode, and I think my first replay will mix in a few of them. title: Lucasfilm wants to do more Star Wars games like Zero Company and Galactic Racer: 'We’ve tried to be more flexible about who we’re willing to take pitches from'
summary: Not every Star Wars game has to be a big-budget blockbuster to be successful.
body: We've had two Star Wars games in 2026, both of them quite good and neither of them quite what you might expect from the Star Wars mould: Zero Company , an XCOM-style tactics game, and Galactic Racer , an arcade racing game but Star Wars. And the success of those games means we may see more like them—which is to say, more offbeat Star Wars games from smaller-scale studios—in the future. Both Zero Company and Galactic Racer were developed by independent studios—Bit Reactor and Fuse Games, respectively—and that "very much is part of the strategy," Lucasfilm Games vice president Douglas Reilly told The Game Business . "Obviously, huge triple-A games like Battlefront are always going to be an essential part of the strategy," Reilly said. "But one of the great things about Star Wars is it has all kinds of other opportunities to tell stories in different genres. "The goal has been to find the best partner who makes that experience come alive inside the galaxy far, far away. title: Two entire pallets of RTX 5090s have 'gone missing' from a Brazilian airport—$495,000 worth of unobtanium graphics cards now presumably at large
summary: Own up, which one of you was it?
body: Good news: I know of the existence of two entire pallets worth of RTX 5090 graphics cards—a rare thing in this day and age, as stock appears to have dwindled to virtually zero . Bad news, they've 'gone missing' from a Brazilian airport. Brazilian electronics distributor Oderço has published an Instagram post drawing attention to the missing Zotac GPUs, which supposedly arrived at Guarulhos International Airport in São Paulo, but then promptly vanished. "In our more than 38-year history, we have never encountered a situation like this—and we will not remain silent," says CEO Oderço Matos (via Tom's Hardware , machine translation). "Two pallets of Zotac RTX 5090 graphics cards have gone missing at Guarulhos International Airport. body: Valve has pushed a new update to its Steam client beta introducing big changes to how achievements work and how they're displayed. Developers can now create sets of achievements customized to their game, like mastering a specific character class or finishing a singleplayer campaign. Sets also distinguish base game achievements from separate DLC and seasonal sets. Previously if you unlocked all achievements for a game you'd see a nice 'n' tidy 100% in your achievements list.
